object.attr: analysis: a commit on a detached HEAD is on no branch, and after the next checkout only git's reflog holds it, so the change looks committed and is lost later (CF-V18, E47). Applies over MCP too. MELLON-STORE-SRS-15 accepts such a root for reading. Answered on 2026-11-11 (the author's question; the review and the analysis agree), to confirm.
object.description: While HEAD is detached, Mellon shall refuse to commit.
